speaker: john_heminges
text: The bag, then. Last Saturday I did not shut it. I did not name a share while it was open, and I am not going to pretend that Saturday had a figure it did not have.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I remember an open bag. I do not remember a sum. If you have one for this week, I would like it before we talk about last week any further.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Twelve shillings. That is the share. The week as played, and nothing folded in from any other purse.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twelve. Say it once more, so I have it as a word and not as a guess.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Twelve shillings. The twenty-fourth of May was thirty-six. I am not subtracting one from the other. I am saying both, because both are true, and they are not a sum together.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Thirty-six was May. Twelve is this bag. I can dislike the distance and still count twelve into my hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Count it. I am not adding it to a coffer while I stand here. The coffer can wait for a day that is for counting coffers.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nobody is counting a coffer. Nobody is sending a quarter home out of this twelve. The quarter has its own day, and this is not that day.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Good. Twelve, shut, and no errand to the Bell hiding inside it. I walked up here to hear a number, not to carry one back to Stratford.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The house played Two Gentlemen at two. You were not in it, Will. The share does not grow a shilling because you stayed at the board, and it does not shrink one either. Twelve is the week's playing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was not in it. I knew the bill. Twelve is enough naming for one Saturday. Shut the bag.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Shut it. I have twelve. I will not ask you what the other house took. I did not see their book, and I do not want a rumour standing next to a counted share.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I have no Rose figure to set beside this, and I will not invent one to make the twelve look brave or look poor. Twelve is itself.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then write twelve, and the date, and that the bag is shut. Last Saturday can stay what it was. An open bag, and no share named.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: And the Monday holiday is still the comedy, as we said on Monday. I am not reopening the almanac to admire it. I am saying the twelve does not buy a new play between now and then.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It does not. The ninth is the comedy we already have. The king is not in this bag. Twelve shillings, the bag shut, and the rest of the map is where we left it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Where we left it. Shut the bag. I am due at a table tomorrow that is not this one, and I am not taking the chronicle to it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then we are done. Twelve shillings. The bag is shut. God keep you till next Saturday, and may it not be another week of learning what thin looks like.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Amen to the twelve, if not to the sermon. I have my share. I am going home to it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twelve. I heard it. I am not going to improve it on the walk.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Do not improve it. Twelve is the number. An improved twelve would be a different week, and this is not that week.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I will say twelve at my own table and no other figure beside it. If anyone asks what the other house took, I will say I was not there.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was not there. I was not in our afternoon either. Twelve has to stand without both of those.

speaker: john_heminges
text: It stands. The bag is shut. I am not opening it again tonight to admire the twelve.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then good night to the bag. Twelve shillings. I heard it the first time.
